My name is nothing big, I am a young man farming here in the North East. This my maize plot is small, only small more than half hectare, so I manage it with my wife and small help. I get some fertilizer from the agro-dealer in town when the price is not too high — I put small urea at top-dressing because without it the maize leaves turn yellow and the cob is poor. I also carry cow dung from my neighbour's kraal to spread before planting because it helps the soil. I cannot irrigate, I wait for the rain like everybody. For weeding I buy one bottle of herbicide because labour is too costly, and I hire two or three boys when the work is too much for my family alone.
